title: Compatible map into a prime-localized pointed triple
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K a field, chi : kappa_R(p) -> K, q a prime of A and psi : kappa_A(q) -> K [def-weil-residue-field]. Assume an A-algebra structure on K such that evaluation at q followed by psi equals its algebra map, whose restriction to R equals evaluation at p followed by chi. For each pointed etale R-triple s [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], there are a pointed etale A-triple t and a ring map beta : B_s -> B_t such that beta composed with alpha_s equals alpha_t composed with R -> A, and evaluation at t.q followed by t.phi composed with beta equals evaluation at s.q followed by s.phi.

source.place: Tags 04GW (pointed triples), 00CP (localization universal property), 00U2 (3) (etale base change). Agent-written construction, not a verbatim theorem.

proof.text: Construct C by localizing B_s at the image of R minus p; the localization universal property gives A -> C and identifies C with A tensor_R B_s. Etale base change gives etaleness over A.

The map f : B_s -> K has kernel s.q, and its restriction to R has kernel p by compatibility and injectivity of chi. Thus all denominators map to units. Extend f to g : C -> K by localization. By hK the composite A -> C -> K agrees with the specified algebra map on R, hence on A by localization uniqueness.

Take Q = ker g and factor g through the fraction field of C/Q, giving the residue-field embedding at Q. The contraction of Q to A is ker(A -> K), which is q by hpsi and injectivity of psi. The resulting triple has the specified pointing, and the two requested equations are the localization extension equations.

      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
